queries.turn5_query: If my employer has been paying me below the correct minimum wage for the past year, how long do I have to file a claim for the underpayment? Is there a deadline?
queries.turn6_reference_answer: Under Article 306 of the Labor Code (formerly Article 291 prior to renumbering), money claims arising from employer-employee relations â€” including underpayment of wages â€” must be filed within three (3) years from the time the cause of action accrued. The prescriptive period runs separately for each pay period in which underpayment occurred: the 3-year clock starts from each payroll date on which the correct minimum wage was not paid. This means if your employer has been underpaying you for the past year, you can still recover all 12 months of underpayment as long as you file within 3 years of each payroll period. Practical step: file a Request for Assistance (RFA) at the nearest DOLE Regional or Field Office under the Single Entry Approach (SEnA) â€” this is the mandatory first step before formal litigation before the NLRC or DOLE arbitration.

queries.query_text: Ano ang Article 102 ng Labor Code tungkol sa pagbabayad ng sahod?
queries.reference_answer: Ayon sa Article 102 ng Labor Code, ang sahod ay dapat bayaran sa legal tender. Hindi pinapayagan ang pagbabayad sa pamamagitan ng promissory notes, vouchers, coupons, tokens, chits, o iba pang paraan maliban sa legal na pera. Bilang eksepsyon, ang pagbabayad sa pamamagitan ng tseke o postal money order ay pinahihintulutan kung ito ay karaniwan sa lugar ng trabaho o kung inirekomenda ng Kalihim ng Paggawa.

I'm in NCR. My company employs kasambahay household helpers on our premises and I need to ensure full wage compliance. Two questions: (1) What is the current minimum wage rate for kasambahay workers in NCR, and our HR received a notice that we must file an 'Annual Establishment Report on Wages' with the DOLE Regional Office — what does this employer compliance report cover and when must it be submitted? (2) Separately, under the 'Wage Rationalization Act', the RTWPBs are 'authorized to determine the daily minimum wage rates' for each region — what is the current NCR rate for regular non-agricultural private sector employees?

queries.reference_answer: Under RA 6727 (Wage Rationalization Act), the Regional Tripartite Wages and Productivity Boards (RTWPBs) are authorized to determine the daily minimum wage rates for each region. For NCR, the current minimum wage for regular non-agricultural private sector employees is ₱610.00 per day under Wage Order NCR-24. Kasambahay (domestic workers) in NCR have a separate monthly minimum wage set by RTWPB-NCR under RA 10361. For the Annual Establishment Report on Wages (AERW), employers must submit it to the DOLE Regional Office covering wage compliance data for all covered employees.

If the regular holiday also coincides with your scheduled rest day, the premium increases to 260% of your daily wage rate. This means if your daily minimum wage in NCR is the rate set under the applicable Wage Order, your pay for working on Christmas Day is twice that daily rate. I'm based in Metro Manila and I am a rank-and-file employee. I worked several overtime and night shifts beyond the regular eight-hour work day that were never properly compensated by my employer. How is extra pay computed for those additional hours, and what rate applies to night work? 'Within the 30 day mandatory conciliation mediation period' can I file an overtime pay claim with DOLE?

queries.reference_answer: For overtime work beyond eight hours per day, you are entitled to an additional 25% of your regular hourly rate under Article 87 of the Labor Code. For work performed between 10:00 PM and 6:00 AM (night shift), you are entitled to a night shift differential of at least 10% of your regular hourly rate under Article 86. When both overtime and night shift apply to the same hours, both premiums apply: the NSD is computed on top of the regular rate. Example: if your hourly rate is ₱100, overtime adds ₱25/hour; night shift adds at least ₱10/hour. You may file a money claim for unpaid overtime and NSD within three years of each payroll period the underpayment occurred.

queries.turn5_query: If my employer refuses to pay the correct premium for that day, what are my options for recovering the underpayment?
queries.turn6_reference_answer: You should first file a Request for Assistance (RFA) under SEnA at the nearest DOLE Regional or Field Office. SEnA provides mandatory conciliation-mediation within 30 days. If conciliation fails, you may file a money claim complaint before the NLRC Regional Arbitration Branch having jurisdiction over your workplace. Money claims for unpaid wages and premium pay must be filed within three (3) years from the date each cause of action accrued (i.e., each payroll period the underpayment occurred). Retain payslips and attendance records as evidence.
